name: vulndb
label: Vulnerability databases
description: Known vulnerabilities in declared dependencies: scan a lock file against OSV.dev, fetch advisories, look up the next safe version. Covers npm, Packagist, Pub and Maven. Needs no credentials.

versions.notes: Declares that it needs no credentials, so covey grants its actions without a vulndb_token or vulndb_url. Needs covey 0.16.0: an older covey ignores the declaration and keeps refusing every action until both secrets are stored.

Adds the Maven ecosystem (Java/Kotlin, Gradle): query and query_batch with groupId:artifactId, gradle.lockfile in scan_lockfile, latest_version from Maven Central. Declares repo1.maven.org as a new host — under enforced egress it has to be allowed.
Was compiled into Covey up to 0.5.0. NVD now answers at its anonymous rate limit: vulndb_token no longer has an effect, because a module is never handed a credential for a host it only declared.
